For q-51078, integration gives v(t)=10t^2-4t^3+2, so the speed at t=2 is 10 ft/s. For q-115108, the visible semiaxes are 6 and 3. For q-115291, q-72251, and q-115293, substituting the source-stated centers and semiaxes into the standard ellipse equation gives the selected equations; their coordinates cannot be independently verified from the supplied images. Axis lengths are twice the semiaxes, giving (4√2,2) for q-16455 and (6,2√5) for q-115311. Setting y=0 gives the x-intercepts: q-9455 has x=1; q-16645 has (x+1)^2=200/9; q-9461 has (x+3)^2=12; q-84031 has x=3. Setting x=0 gives the y-intercepts: q-9463 has y=-2; q-70185 has (y-2)^2=12; q-9472 has (y-3)^2=3; q-84046 has y^2=-9 and therefore no real intercepts; q-84048 has (y+2)^2=16 and therefore y=-6 or 2.
